historical_review_note.diagnosis: Both Native constant and Variable inputs match the independent generator oracle within 1.3e-15. Both pinned PennyLane versions throw TypeError for the constant and pass the Variable path. The original strict failure is retained; Native does not copy the reference defect.
historical_review_note.next: Propose only a reference-observation contract migration, retaining constant input, independent Native mathematics and Variable comparison without changing interfaces or tolerances.
historical_review_note.diagnosis_zh: 已分别实测：Native 常量和 Variable 都匹配独立生成元公式，误差小于 1.3e-15；指定两个 PennyLane 版本的常量输入均抛 TypeError，而 Variable 路径通过。原严格测试仍保留失败，不把上游错误复制进 Native。
historical_review_note.next_zh: 仅提出公共参考观察合同的迁移决策，保留常量输入、Native 独立数学和 Variable 比较；不替换接口，不降低容差。

historical_review_note.diagnosis: Caching the value function reproduces all four for/rof failures regardless of outer derivative caching. In both environments raw TensorFlow cos also returns None for cached rof while for is correct. Native additionally has false third-order refusal and all-zero behavior; the framework control does not waive those failures. Unsuccessful candidates did not change production guards or old formulas.
historical_review_note.next: Separate Native point/cotangent/direction linear rules from cached graph composition, retaining the no-quantum-library TF control. Preserve both quantum and external-loss curvature, not only one HVP contribution.
historical_review_note.diagnosis_zh: 只要量子取值函数被缓存，四个 for/rof 案例仍失败，外层求导是否缓存并非必要条件。两个环境的纯 TensorFlow cos 最小对照也在缓存 rof 中返回 None，但 for 正确；Native 另有三阶误判及全零问题，不能以框架对照失败豁免。候选修复未通过，未改生产保护和旧公式。
